questions.question: When the king asked Queen Esther what she wanted, how much did he say he would give her?
When the king offered to grant her request, what did Queen Esther ask him to do?

answers.text: Come with Haman to her banquet today
End the law against the Jews
Pardon Mordecai at the king's gate

questions.question: When Haman passed Mordecai at the king's gate, what did Mordecai do?

answers.text: He did not rise or tremble
He bowed down to the ground
He got up and walked away

questions.question: When Haman was angry about Mordecai, what did his wife Zeresh and his friends tell him to have built?

answers.text: A prison next to the gate
A tower over the city wall
